steps.content: You no longer remember what happened after that.
Only fragmented memories remain. On that battlefield, you seemed to hear Jelena's voice.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...${PlayerName}... Wake up, wake up...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: It's all right, I'm here to save you... I won't let you die...
You attempted to speak, yet no words could escape your lips. You only felt someone holding you in a grief-stricken embrace.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Who did this? Who hurt him... say it!
steps.female_content: ...Who did this? Who hurt her... say it!

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Was it you?
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Don't even think about taking him. Not a single step closer, I warn you.
steps.female_content: Don't even think about taking her. Not a single step closer, I warn you.

steps.content: (Flashback)
The final memory etched in your mind is of that slender woman, standing alone against a horde of formidable adversaries.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: The military...?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Anyone who dares lay a finger on my children... is DEAD.
You wake up.
You find yourself already back at the Bureau, surrounded by familiar faces wearing expressions of deep concern. The recent happenings seem like nothing but a fading nightmare.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm fine. Thank you, everyone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where's S9... and Jelena...?
Their silence tells everything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jelena's in the infirmary, right? I'll go check on her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I have questions to ask her.
In the end, however, you can't bring yourself to ask any of them.
At the entrance to the ward, Elvira remains by the bedside. You've heard that she hasn't slept in two days. Her shoulders tremble as she tightly holds onto Jelena's hand.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Please don't cry, El... Sable will come back. Chief went to find her... She will come back to us...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Mmm...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: You still have me, and so many others to protect you... Everything will be alright...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Mmm...!

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I will never leave you alone...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: That song... Would you like to hear it again? Your favorite one...
You remember this song.
The melody feels unfamiliar, the lyrics indistinct, reminding you of both a lullaby and a requiem.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Jelena's power is spiraling out of control. The shackles within her body have become unstable and can no longer restrain her Mania.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief... What enemies were you up against? How did she end up like this?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: About those two... Give them some special care, just do what I said.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now... back to work.

These days, you have immersed yourself in scrutinizing every document and pursuing every lead, working through meals and late into the night. Despite the numerous instances of denied access, you persist by seeking alternative routes to probe into the cases.
Call it luck—an unexpected mail arrives just in time, providing the final crucial piece of the puzzle.

Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 30th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! I'm the investigator Max King hired. Found something interesting, figured I'd pass it along to you as well. Check the attached. Pine Attachment: [Internal Memo]
